rule: SMB Iron condor (5-delta campaign) campaign: 44d, delta 0.05, width 1%, PT 90%
description: SMB SPX iron-condor year [m8R_564Kp6k]: ~60-CALENDAR-day condors with 5-delta short strikes, ~90% per-trade probability, credits ~6-7% of margin; SMB's credit-structure management is capture ~75-90% of max profit and redeploy [TpAPTwLMb44] - modeled as a 90% profit-take. Wings 1% wide (defined risk). NOT modeled: the delta-doubling defensive roll. Parameters here: 44 trading days, short-leg delta 0.05, width 1%, profit-take 90% (all editable via --smb-dte/--smb-delta/--smb-width-pct/--smb-profit-take-pct). Continuous campaign: a new cycle opens at the close whenever flat. r = cycle P&L / max risk; 1% of equity per cycle.
note: BSM-priced from our quote history; sigma frozen at cycle entry; friction = 3% of option price capped at 0.3% of spot per leg; expiry settles intrinsic. NOT modeled: early assignment, dividends, vol smile, delta-doubling defensive rolls, the wheel's post-assignment covered-call phase, trend filters on the PCS campaign, and the earnings/0DTE-intraday SMB strategies (event/intraday data - out of scope).
